title: Compact size and hatchback practicality
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the car's compact size as easy to live with, while many other mentions simply note that it is compact without stating a clear opinion.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the compact dimensions for being appealing, practical, and paired with a larger-car feel or good performance.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions mostly state that the car is compact or a compact car without enough context to tell whether that is meant as praise or simple description.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short standalone mentions of 'compact' or 'compact car,' which limits detail about specific benefits or tradeoffs.
The sampled examples provide little direct evidence about hatchback-related practicality beyond the broader compact-size theme.
